Water's Edge: Have you ever been to the water's edge? Maybe there's one in your hometown. I feel at peace but energized at the same time. Ready for adventure. The ocean has a way with waves to make us all feel something. How does the ocean make you feel?

24” X 36” Mixed media acrylic painting with organic plaster base layer on gallery wrapped canvas. Ready to hand.

For serious inquiries please email vudiphothisukart@gmail.com
